meta.name: product
meta.description: Product-oriented thinking for understanding user needs, prioritizing features, and designing solutions. Use when the task involves product decisions, feature prioritization, or understanding user impact.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用产品思维梳理需求,排定功能优先级
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果常要在有限资源里取舍做什么功能
copy.tagline_en: Prioritize features by understanding user needs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often decide which features to build or cut

howto.what: 装上后,当讨论产品相关任务时,Claude 会按产品思维框架引导:先定义用户问题(现状、痛点、期望、成功指标),再按权重给功能排优先级,并画出解决方案的用户流程、数据流、错误状态和边界情况。它还能用模板输出功能规格,包括用户故事、验收标准、API、错误状态等。
howto.when: 当任务涉及产品决策、功能优先级排序或理解用户影响时触发,例如要求分析功能、设计解决方案等。

say.text: 帮我定义这个功能要解决的用户问题。
say.note: Claude 会按现状、痛点、期望、成功指标来梳理。

say.text: 给这几个功能按优先级排个序。
say.note: Claude 会按用户影响、商业价值等权重打分。

say.text: 用功能规格模板描述这个新功能。
say.note: Claude 会输出用户故事、验收标准等内容。

howto.what_en: Claude guides product tasks: define user problem (current behavior, pain, desired behavior, success metric), prioritize features by weighted scores, sketch user/data flows, errors, edge cases, and output feature specs (user story, acceptance criteria, API, error states).
howto.when_en: Triggers when a task involves product decisions, feature prioritization, or understanding user impact, such as analyzing features or designing solutions.

say_en.text: Help me define the user problem this feature solves.

say_en.note: Claude scores by user impact, business value, effort, risk, dependencies.

say_en.text: Write a feature spec for this new feature.
say_en.note: Claude uses the template covering user story, acceptance criteria, API, etc.
